cases.name: defaults-mass8200

expected.verdict: DEGENERATE — Δσ_los 1.1 km/s (0.5σ); no-IMBH model reproduces the central dispersion within measurement errors.

cases.note: NOT hand-derivable in closed form: computeProfile() solves the anisotropic Jeans equation by backward trapezoidal quadrature on a 40-pt log-radius grid, then an Abel-transform line-of-sight projection by an 80-pt z-integral with linear interpolation between grid points -- there is no closed-form antiderivative for the tool own Plummer(cluster)+Plummer(remnant)+IMBH composite density used as the source term. Per OCS-FIXWAVE.md FW-1 guidance for MC tools (extended here to this deterministic-but-numerical-integration case): this fixture freezes the tool own live buildArtifact() output at a fixed input, asserting reproducibility of the grid/quadrature scheme, not independent closed-form correctness. The two boundary terms sigma_los_no_imbh_km_s (beta=0,mrem=0 case) and any input at mass=0 ARE independently checkable analytically as a sanity cross-check if a future session wants to tighten this.
